issues.description: The template's addGuestStudents method signature (public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents, boolean validateInput)) does not match the problem statement and the solution, both of which specify addGuestStudents(int). This mismatch will confuse students about the correct method signature to implement and can cause compilation or grading mismatches if tests expect the single-parameter version.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template method signature match the problem statement and solution by changing the template to: public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents) { /* TODO */ }. If input validation is desired, implement it internally or provide an overloaded/auxiliary method but keep the public API as specified in the exercise description and UML.
